correctness.rationale: The restricted-growth enumerator exhausts all ternary letter-equivalence classes and checks all three Parikh coordinates at each proper prefix border length. A logically independent program exhausts all 3^(n-1) words with first letter zero, then divides nonconstant fibers by exactly two; both independently yield identical 16-row tables and full 353-level n=16 histograms. For n=16 the histogram sums to 1,151,825 arrays and its multiplicity-weighted sum to 7,174,454 canonical generators; it has 468,549 singleton arrays and one maximum 16,384 class. The all-zero maximum-fiber theorem is proved by the equivalence b_i=i-1 iff w_i=w_1, and includes n=2 exceptional normalized tie. Four-bit packing is injective because n<=16. The finite programs are exhaustive, not stochastic experiments.
